definitions.explanation: Indicates that something happens prior to another event or time.
Indicates a position in front of something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{前|まえ}に⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧。
examples.english: I wash my hands before eating.
examples.notes: Time: verb dictionary form + 前に

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧{前|まえ}に⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please read a book before going to bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧{前|まえ}に⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}めて→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please close the door before going out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧{前|まえ}に、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んでいます→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I drink coffee every day before work starts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧{前|まえ}に⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暗|くら}くして→暗い：00647_kurai⟧、⟦{静|しず}かな→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧やすく⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you make the room dark and listen to quiet music before sleeping at night, it becomes easier to fall asleep.
Let's meet in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前|まえ}に⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a big tree in front of the school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前|まえ}に⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦お{待|ま}ちください→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: Please sit in front of me and wait.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前|まえ}に⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧5⟦{分|ふん}→分：00928_fun⟧⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The library is in front of the park. It's about a 5-minute walk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前|まえ}に⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧で、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっています→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The big tree standing in front of the house was brought here by my grandfather when he was young, and now it has become a family memory.

notes:
{前|まえ}に has two distinct uses: temporal (before) and spatial (in front of).

TIME PATTERNS:
- [verb dictionary form] + {前|まえ}に: before doing...
- [noun] + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前|まえ}に: before [noun]

LOCATION PATTERN:
- [noun] + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前|まえ}に: in front of [noun]

OPPOSITES:
- Time: ⟦{後|あと}で→後で：00920_atode⟧ / ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (after)
- Location: ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (behind)

{前|まえ}に VS {前|まえ}:
{前|まえ}に emphasizes the point in time/space; {前|まえ} alone can modify nouns ({前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ = the previous day).

NOTE: Unlike ⟦{後|あと}で→後で：00920_atode⟧, {前|まえ}に always uses ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, never ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧.
